title: The Flats
summary: Harbor Phase works too well. The group reconnects around a Reach window, gathers at the floodwall, crosses the exposed flats, and sees the Reach emerge through fog as a drowned future rather than simple ruins.

title: The Dead Mall
summary: The group enters the Near Reach and discovers Fashion Harbor Center. The flooded mall becomes the first temporary runner society; social belonging and practical danger coexist. The group exits toward the Glass Rail as the tide begins to return.

title: No Signal
summary: Repeat crossings create tide culture. Harbor Market Roof shows the Reach as an unmediated social world: Matt becomes useful, Chris mythologizes, Justin seeks audience, Nicole witnesses structure, Kevin warns softly, and Ryan sees attachment becoming dangerous.
